description: $500–$1,000 for Gaston or Cleveland County students at NC State's College of Engineering or College of Physical & Mathematical Sciences.
eligibility_text: Resident of Gaston or Cleveland County; accepted and enrolled at NC State University in the College of Physical & Mathematical Sciences or College of Engineering, completing a four-year degree. Ranked on community service, school performance, class rank, music/arts interests, and financial need.
